quality_assessment: Chapter is comprehensive and accurate with excellent coverage of context display features. Only minor improvements suggested for completeness.

issues.description: Chapter doesn't mention that context flags can accept values up to usize::MAX
issues.should_add: Document that context values can be very large (tested up to usize::MAX in the codebase)
issues.fix_suggestion: Add a note in the basic options section mentioning that large context values are supported for edge cases

issues.description: The override behavior between context flags and passthru could be more detailed
issues.current_content:
Context flags override passthru behavior
rg --passthru -C 2 pattern  # Only shows 2 lines of context, not all lines
issues.should_add: Document that the last flag wins: --passthru after -A/-B/-C enables passthru mode, while -A/-B/-C after --passthru enables context mode
issues.fix_suggestion: Add examples showing both orders: 'rg -A5 --passthru' (passthru wins) vs 'rg --passthru -A5' (context wins)

issues.description: Chapter doesn't mention escape sequence support in field separators
issues.should_add: Document that field separators support escape sequences like \t, \x00, \xFF for special characters
issues.fix_suggestion: Add an example showing escape sequences: 'rg --field-match-separator '\t' pattern' for tab-separated output

issues.description: The distinction between empty separator and no-context-separator is explained but could be clearer with visual examples
issues.current_content:
The difference between empty separator and --no-context-separator:
- --context-separator '' removes the -- separator but keeps a blank line between groups
- --no-context-separator removes all separation, making match groups flow continuously
issues.should_be: Add side-by-side output examples showing the visual difference between the two modes
issues.fix_suggestion: Add concrete output examples showing what the output looks like with each option to make the distinction crystal clear
